title: Jude and the Extraction
author: Emrys Sandoval
blurb: Ulyana Zhou, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
